comments.text: With groundwater dropping to nearly 109 meters [46:12], concrete sealing off natural absorption [47:56], and roughly 1,000 to 2,000 people arriving daily due to floods and river erosion [56:15], Dhaka faces compounding pressures [53:22]. When climate displacement keeps feeding growth [58:13], is pouring more infrastructure into Dhaka the answer, or should investment shift toward secondary cities and rural resilience?
